key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.44% significantly breaching the upper tolerance band, primarily driven by a sharp 11.51% spike in food inflation, our primary focus must remain on anchoring inflation expectations. While GVA growth remains resilient at 7.80%, the current liquidity surplus and the need to ensure durable price stability necessitate maintaining the withdrawal of accommodation stance to align inflation with the 4.00% target.
